title: optiland-sms: SMS lens surfaces in Optiland's sequential engine
description: Miñano-Benítez SMS (Simultaneous Multiple Surface) lens surfaces as an Optiland plugin: a spline span of a ray-tracing-shapely profile.json becomes a sequential surface of revolution, sms_spline, traced exactly and, under Optiland's torch backend, differentiable with respect to the spline's points. Registered through Optiland's entry point; it depends on Optiland only.
